_comment: Hard escalation triggers that fire regardless of what the model would have done. Keyword lists are intentionally simple/greppable — this is a prototype guardrail, not an NLP classifier, and it's meant to fail toward escalating too often rather than too rarely. Edit these lists directly; no code change needed.
no_progress_note: If the last N consecutive outbound (bot) turns for a conversation made zero tool calls, treat it as stuck and escalate rather than let it spin further.

pre_send_guardrail.note: Not a keyword list — src/guardrails/preSend.ts implements dollar-figure whitelisting (any $ amount in a draft reply must exactly match a number returned by a tool call this turn) and a date-commitment heuristic (a commitment verb near a date/timeframe token). Documented here so this file stays the single index of 'what guards this bot', even though the logic itself lives in code.
